mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(register_count), 0) AS registerCount, -- 挂号人次 NVL(SUM(payment_count), 0) AS paymentCount, -- 收费人次 NVL(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refundCount -- 退费人次 FROM TR_WIN_STAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT age_group AS ageGroup, -- 年龄段 NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount -- 人数 FROM TR_WIN_STAT_AGE WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(age_group, '[0-9]+')) ASC
SELECT time_slot AS timeSlot, -- 时段 NVL(SUM(business_count), 0) AS businessCount -- 业务量 FROM TR_WIN_STAT_TM WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY time_slot ORDER BY time_slot

SELECT source_name AS sourceName, -- 来源名称 NVL(SUM(source_count), 0) AS sourceCount -- 数量 FROM TR_WIN_STAT_SRC WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY source_name ORDER BY sourceCount DESC

SELECT business_type AS businessType, -- 业务类型(挂号/收费/退费) time_slot AS timeSlot, -- 时段 NVL(SUM(business_count), 0) AS businessCount -- 业务量 FROM TR_WIN_STAT_TM WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY business_type,time_slot ORDER BY business_type
